Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in September?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (14% odds) on crude reach $110. Closes in 11d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $80 in September?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Tail-risk bet (6% odds) on crude drop below $80. Closes in 11d. A move this low would ease diesel and nitrogen input cost pressure heading into side-dress and summer ops.
